_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro: {num_players}-Ciyaaryahanka ku hareereysan shabakad {width}x{height}. Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahan {player_id}. Dhaqdhaqaaqyada saxda ah: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' [right]' ama w / s / a / d. Ujeedada: ka badbaado qof walba. Wadooyinka waa kuwo dilaa ah; derbiga ayaa dilaa; shil madaxa ah ayaa dilaa labadaba.

board.after_moves: Guddiga ka dib isku mar la dhaqaaqo: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ayaa u dhintay sabab la xiriirta dhaqaaq aan ansax ahayn.

outcome.survived_win: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuu badbaaday; dhammaan kuwa kale way burbureen.
outcome.all_crashed: Dhamaan ciyaartoydu waxay ku burbureen isla waqtigaas.
outcome.outlived: Ciyaaryahanka ayaa ka badbaaday kuwa kale oo dhan.
outcome.turn_limit: Xadka wareega ayaa la gaaray - qofka ugu dheer ee badbaada ayaa guuleysta.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Kooxaha darajooyinka ugu dambeeya (ugu fiican→ugu xun): {groups}
